//: Per-wave persona sets: each wave of a parallel regression signs in as its own copy of the personas several waves share, so one wave's carts, addresses and sign-ins never move another's. A clone is the alias <ALIAS>_<SET> (aliases.json), a row of its own in the persona's CSV (same org, role and password token, its own login), generated by `npm run td:gen:wave-personas` — never edited by hand. A run selects its set with `regression:plan --persona-set <SET>` (or QA_PERSONA_SET); release.json gives each wave its set. Design: .claude/skills/qa-run/release-folder.md §7.1.
